name: @buka/dsh-plugin-robots
description: Adds a Robots page to the sidebar that creates and manages its own robots: a robot is a directory under ~/.cache/dsh-plugin-robots/robots mounted as a DSH workspace, with project-level skills installed through npx skills, an editable AGENTS.md, and a one-click session. Every robot has a preset avatar and a one-sentence responsibility statement (the buka_robots tool returns it so a workflow orchestrator can decide whether to use that robot), and the ctx.bukaRobots service exposes list(), avatarMap(), a blocking startSession and non-blocking dispatchSession / openSession with an observable handle (dispatchSession / openSession also accept an optional planMode flag that switches the session into DSH plan mode before the first prompt, and the handle can read and clear that mode; the service advertises supportsPlanMode); every robot session always submits a structured JSON result through the scoped structured_output tool (optionally constrained by outputSchema and workflow route names, with bounded result retries and an optional abortable escape for workflow nodes), runs as a normal runtime-root conversation under the normal approval policy, and can be continued by session id after compacting its history. Installing the plugin also ships the robot-builder mode (an agent preset carried by its bundle patch) that interviews the user, drafts the robot AGENTS.md, then creates and mounts the robot through the preset-gated buka_robot_build tool. On a fresh install (an empty registry) the plugin seeds two preset robots — 软件工程师 (software engineer) and 质量保障工程师 (QA engineer) — as ordinary, editable robots.
